# Player Died

Source: [wiki article 4818](../archive/4818.md); edited 2024-11-26.

<a id="wiki-4818-n1"></a>

- Player Died has Event Player equal Victim; Attacker is final-blow dealer (same on suicide). Context exposes received damage, critical hit, ability and incoming direction.
